findings.evidence: "This request timed out before it could finish."
findings.fix: Add an action suggestion: "This request timed out. Please try again or adjust your search criteria."
findings.violation: The message describes what went wrong but does not suggest any action the user can take to resolve the problem.

findings.evidence: "No orders fall inside the selected date range. Change the date range, or clear the filters to see every order."
findings.fix: Clarify the recommended action path: "No orders match your date range. Clear the date filter to see all orders, or adjust the range to see a different set."
findings.violation: The message contains two separate instructions (change the date range OR clear the filters) but the structure makes it unclear which action is primary or recommended.

findings.evidence: "Sync is paused while this device is on a metered connection, so syncing does not spend a data allowance. Select resume to sync now."
findings.fix: Clarify the action: "Sync is paused on metered connections to save your data allowance. Tap 'Resume syncing' when ready."
findings.violation: The phrasing "Select resume to sync now" is ambiguous about whether "resume" is a button name or an action verb.
